question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Precarious
solution:
The correct answer is "Safe".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• Let us understand the** meaning **of the **given** and the** marked words.**

 
 
• Precarious means** something not safe or certain or dangerous**.

 
 
• Synonyms: Dangerous or hazardous or risky.

 
 
• Example: *The library is in a financially precarious position.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Safe means something not likely to cause danger, harm or risk.
 
 
• Synonyms: Secure or guarded.
 
 
• Example:* This neighborhood is safe from robbers.*
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "safe" is the antonym of "precarious".
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1) Safe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the other given** words**.

 
 
• Dangerous **means something/someone likely to cause injury or damage.
 
• **Uncertain** means something not known exactly or not decided.
 
• Perilous means something involving a great risk or danger.
